name: Marko Vešligaj - Proposition de résolution de remplacement - Am 4
title: REPORT on the Gender Equality Strategy 2025
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to draw up a new plan for gender equality covering 2026 to 2030. The report is a set of demands, not a law. It calls for action against violence towards women, better and equal healthcare, fair pay, affordable care for children and older people, and more women in politics and decision-making jobs. It also asks for money and monitoring so the promises are actually carried out.

- The report asks the Commission to propose a gender equality plan for 2026–2030; nothing changes yet.
- It affects women and girls across the EU, plus employers, health services and national governments.
- Next, the Commission decides whether to act on these demands; Parliament would then scrutinise the result.
